method.estimator: geometric mean + Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance, 252-day annualised
method.expected_returns: the average return over the whole training window
method.tangency: frontier._solve max_sharpe at the cutoff's ^IRX yield
caveats: the test windows are nested, so the cutoffs are not independent trials
the universe is 14 instruments that exist today with quotes back to the start date, so every asset tested survived the period
no transaction costs, no taxes, no slippage
method.rolling: 5.0y training window walked forward in non-overlapping holding periods over the last 16.0y
